- 4-week evaluation window (dev -> integration -> pilot)
- Two EB syncs: kickoff + final approval (60min each) with VP+ sponsor attendance

2) We finalize MAP and send calendar series + pre-read

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min sync if it helps.
